answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24128 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: I am working in a company as a engineer so as per my designation i am the person who placing orders for department requirments. i just want to ask is getting commision from vendor or supplier is HALAL or HARAM.. is there no harm for the company with my commision. Question: Assalam Alaikum, i am working in a company as a engineer so as per my designation i am the person who placing orders for department requirments. i just want to ask is getting commision from vendor or supplier is HALAL or HARAM.. is there no harm for the company with my commision. Answer ID: 24128 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1141/1141/M=1431) In the question mentioned above, it is not lawful for you to take commission from shopkeeper or supplier. It is bribe. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
